name: device
title: Device
description: The body of a phone around a screenshot, a video or a running demo.
use: Showing a small-screen interface on a page: a screenshot in a hero, a recording, a live preview. The frame is one material with no color of its own, so it suits any picture and both themes. Resize it with --device-width, so the corner and the bezel follow.

instead.when: What is shown is a desktop application, a site or a terminal
The picture needs a caption and no frame

classes.name: device
classes.description: The body: a lifted sheet 280px wide and 9 by 19.5, with a narrow bezel, the camera's well and the side buttons

classes.name: device-screen
classes.description: The screen, on an image, a video, a frame or a block of markup: it fills the body inside the bezel and is finished by a corner concentric with the body's

properties.name: --device-width
properties.description: The body's width; the corner and the bezel are measured from it

properties.name: --device-radius
properties.description: The body's corner, as a circular radius

properties.name: --device-bezel
properties.description: Width of the frame around the screen
